name: application-progress-toast-group
title: Progress Toast Group
description: Stack of concurrent task-progress toasts, each with its own progress bar and Done state — distinct from toast-stack, whose toasts are plain messages without per-toast progress.
useWhen: Multiple background tasks (uploads, exports, batch jobs) are running concurrently and each needs its own visible progress.
You want each toast's bar width and "Done" label driven by the real progress/completion state.
Completed tasks should offer a Dismiss action while in-progress ones don't.
avoidWhen: You only need plain success/error/info messages with no progress bar — use toast-stack instead.
There's only ever one concurrent task — a single inline progress bar is simpler than a toast group.
Tasks need to be cancellable mid-progress — add a cancel action to the in-progress state in your own fork.
responsiveBehavior: The group is a fixed max-width column (24rem) meant for a fixed corner position; each toast's label truncates rather than wrapping.
accessibility: The group wrapper carries aria-live='polite' and aria-label='Task progress' so screen readers announce progress changes without interrupting.
Each toast's progress bar carries role='img' with an aria-label stating the task name and percent or completion, since bar width alone isn't announced.
Completed tasks switch their bar to green and label to 'Done', conveying completion by both color and text, not color alone.

variants.title: Progress toast group
variants.description: Three concurrent tasks — two in progress (42%, 78%) and one complete with a Dismiss action, on a light surface.
accessibility: Only the completed toast shows a Dismiss action, since in-progress toasts represent work still underway.

variants.title: Progress toast group (Dark)
variants.description: The same three concurrent tasks, adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: Toast, bar, and text colors must meet WCAG AA contrast on dark backgrounds.
